text:
ana (PM): Heads-up: I'm drafting a compact DP triage + ops playbook to help us pick 8 partners next quarter. Want a very practical rubric (prioritization + incentives + launch gates) we can use in one pass. Sharing a seed idea, please flag anything missing.

cole (Eng): Love a compact rubric. Two quick asks: (1) require load-script + 20 golden prompts pre-accept, and (2) a simple engineering cost estimate field (dev days). Without that we underspec infra work.

maya (CS): From CS: require named tech lead + weekly 30m commitment. Offer 8 hours PS for onboarding by default. Also want an explicit rollback step in the playbook: if partner hits >1 P1 in 7 days, pause and revert.

lee (Sales): Sales wants an "opt-in conversion pathway" on acceptance: partner ticks a box if they'd consider Dedicated commit on success. Helps us surface qualified upsell leads. Also ask for estimated ARR on intake.

nora (Research): Add artifact requirements for evaluation: ordered prompts (15-25), 3 user scenarios, and a short baseline run. Mid-pilot qualitative check-ins are critical — recommend 30m at week 3.

alaa (Legal): Short pilot addendum template OK. Need toggles: data-sharing consent, de-id permission, and case-study opt-in. If PHI/reg data is flagged, auto-class to "compliance" bucket requiring VPC/on-prem.

ana (PM): Seed scoring rubric (proposal):
```
- Product validation (0-5): closeness to roadmap hypothesis
- Operational burden (0-4): dev days + infra risk (lower is better)
- Business impact (0-4): ARR + strategic fit
- Artifact readiness (0-2): prompts + scenarios present
Accept if >= 9, or >= 8 with exec sponsor tag. Prioritize by product validation on ties.
```

cole (Eng): Instrumentation checklist: `dp.onboard.start`, `dp.onboard.first_inference`, `dp.onboard.rollback`, `dp.eval.prompt_count`. Also add feature flags: `pilot/dp-X` + `pilot/fallback-hosted`.

maya (CS): Feedback cadence: weekly async digest + biweekly 45m working sessions. Require partners to upload eval artifacts to the intake folder by day 7.

lee (Sales): Incentives: pick one per accepted partner — credits-only, credits+PS(8h), or paid case-study stipend. Keep options small to avoid negotiation overhead.

nora (Research): Success gates for recommending conversion:
- Integration: first inference within 7 days
- Stability: no P1s for 2 consecutive weeks
- Quality: no unexplained regression on partner prompts
- Business: partner expresses conversion intent or shows clear usage growth
If 3/4 pass -> eligible for conversion outreach.

alaa (Legal): Will prepare pilot addendum and a de-id checkbox. Also note: PS hours convert to billable if we don't sign a conversion contract within 60 days.

ana (PM): Owners / next steps:
- ana: landing playbook + intake form (EOD Wed)
- cole: compatibility script + events (Thu)
- maya: CS onboarding checklist + rollback play (Thu)
- nora: artifact templates + mid-pilot interview script (Wed)
- alaa: pilot addendum draft (Thu)
I'll run a 30-min sync Thurs to finalize language before opening intake. Any objections?

cole (Eng): No objections. Will start the script.

maya (CS): ok from CS.

lee (Sales): all good.

alaa (Legal): fine — will prioritize draft.

dp-bot: New intake row created: "spectrum-ai" (tags: retail, interested in credits+PS).

ana (PM): Thanks team  Ill post the intake when drafts are in.
